title_zh: 京拉携手“送智上门” 共绘区域文创品牌建设新图景
title_en: Beijing and Lhasa Cooperate to Boost Regional Cultural Creative Brand Building
summary_zh: 北京与拉萨携手开展“送智上门”活动，共同推进区域文创品牌建设，助力两地文化产业发展。
summary_en: Beijing and Lhasa have launched a joint 'send wisdom' initiative to boost regional cultural and creative brand development, supporting cultural industry growth in both cities.
